Summary For the second quarter of 2026, the PGIM Income Builder Fund underperformed the benchmark but outperformed the peers. The Equity Income sleeve advanced but underperformed the S&P 500 Index—which gained 15.2% for the period. The High Yield sleeve underperformed its benchmark, the Bloomberg High-Yield 1% Issuer Capped Bond Index, for the quarter.
